foundation: Frozen Kumo Large, 90 V5 columns, E8, 50,000 context rows, matching five folds seed 31027
correction_training: 6,000 outer-training rows excluded from the Kumo context; never outer-validation labels
encoder: Signed log numeric, median imputation, quadratic quantile splines with three knots, standardization, missing indicators, one-hot employment type; fitted only on correction-training rows
objective: Mean weighted binary cross entropy with frozen Kumo logit offset and L2 penalty; intercept unpenalized. The balanced prior shift is used only inside the loss, so zero correction preserves the original population probabilities.
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, maxiter=300, ftol=1e-11, gtol=1e-7; require success and max gradient <1e-4
final_blend: 75% corrected Kumo + 25% original spline on matching outer folds
selection: Evaluate all eight fixed recipes on the same full five-fold OOF. Do not fit a correction using all-fold OOF labels and evaluate it on those same rows.
limitation: Repeated research still reuses training labels and splits; this is not untouched holdout.
